argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='E:\work\video2-r25-local'
$run='E:\work\video2-r25-local-run'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $run | Out-Null
if((git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'b11a93664f9b64bf6da626119758c841a0a75c1e'){ throw 'HEAD drift' }
if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((git -C $repo status --porcelain) -join ''))){ throw 'repo dirty' }
$cmd=@'
@echo off
cd /d E:\work\video2-r25-local
if exist E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.exit del /q E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.exit
call npm run test:r25 > E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.log 2>&1
echo %ERRORLEVEL%> E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused.exit
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $run 'focused.cmd') -Value $cmd -Encoding ASCII
Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $run 'focused.log') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $run 'focused.exit') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList @('/c',(Join-Path $run 'focused.cmd')) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
[pscustomobject]@{pid=$p.Id;runner=(Join-Path $run 'focused.cmd');log=(Join-Path $run 'focused.log');exit=(Join-Path $run 'focused.exit');head=(git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
